benchmark_identity.name: KE-memory diagnostic benchmark v1
purpose: Build, inspect and expand a frozen foundational ontology that covers common memory situations.
Measure natural-expression to canonical-ontology mapping without letting the mapper leak benchmark answers.
Expose extraction, abstraction, retrieval, execution and answer failures on natural memory benchmarks.
Determine whether failures belong to implementation, ontology coverage or architecture, and attribute them to the correct module.

execution_stages.gate_semantics: A blocked gate is not a failure of the memory system and carries no diagnostic claim. It blocks execution until its input is supplied. Stage 0 may not be marked complete while any gate is blocked or pending.

budget_finding_resolved.original_observation: Five LongMemEval questions carry gold evidence larger than the original 8192-token budget, one needing roughly 18000 tokens, so no arm could reach delivery exact match on them.
budget_finding_resolved.residual: fixture_lexical_retrieval still reports budget_limited on 20 of 32 items because it selects very broadly (up to 188 units, about 130K tokens) and delivery caps at 24K. That is the metric split working as intended: broad selection followed by bounded delivery is exactly the distinction the earlier single figure hid.
budget_finding_resolved.resolution: The delivery budget is preregistered at 24576 tokens, which covers the largest gold set. Selection and delivery exact match now agree for every arm, and budget_limited_count is reported rather than samples being dropped.

defects_found_and_fixed: The Stage 0 work_model probe and prompts/answer/system.md contained no occurrence of json while running in json_object mode, so DeepSeek rejected every such request. Unreachable by the test suite because all tests inject fake clients.
The thinking control was sent as a top-level kwarg, which the OpenAI SDK rejects outright; it must travel in extra_body.

The regression-slice loader addressed evidence by loop index while gold addressed it by unit_id, and gold records were coerced with str() into stringified dicts. Both defects drove every evidence metric to zero while the harness still reported success.
MemoryFreezeProof.artifact trusted current state, so a proof whose build_count had been raised via model_copy could still render a valid freeze claim. It now re-validates.
The settings test fixture cleared credential environment variables but not the repository .env.local, so creating real credentials broke two previously passing tests.
known_limitations: Every arm and pipeline stage in this run is a lexical fixture reported under a fixture identity. The numbers describe the fixtures, not the ontology path. Stage 2 substitutes the real symbolic backend behind the same interfaces.
Answer generation is a deterministic stub, so answer correctness, abstention correctness and constraint satisfaction are all recorded as unknown rather than computed.

The four per-layer oracles are validated only on a two-question synthetic fixture. That proves the substitution mechanism works; it does not measure anything about the slice, and the slice run withholds those four layers for lack of annotation.
The oracle stages substitute stages of the diagnostic pipeline, not yet of the production memory path, so attribution claims are about the harness until Stage 2 wires the backend.
full_history is context limited on 10 of 32 slice items because the conversations exceed a 128000-token context. On those items it is a truncated-history condition, not a capability ceiling.

tests/contract/test_online_keol_bridge.py still cannot be collected: it imports the onto package from the private genuineknowledge/KEOL repository, which returns 404 anonymously. No repository-wide pass is claimed.
The judge was verified only as proxy-declared, and the judge key still requires rotation before any further judge call.
findings.oracle_falsifiability_check: gold_evidence_selection reaches selection exact match of 1.000. The other four layers are validated on a synthetic fixture with independently authored per-layer gold: each is asserted to change its own stage, and the cumulative series rises from 0.000 to 1.000 once all four are applied. A zero marginal rate for a single layer means necessary-but-not-sufficient, not inert, which is why both marginal and cumulative figures are reported.

execution_stages.name: diagnostic harness foundation
outputs: unified public-input loader for BEAM, LoCoMo and LongMemEval
three arm adapters sharing one question, model, budget and result contract
five oracle substitutions confined to the evaluation diagnostic layer
32-item slice public/gold separation loader with a freeze-once proof
ESEM, All-Evidence at K, constraint satisfaction and answer-evidence matrix
harness validation report over synthetic fixtures and the 32-item regression
execution_stages.produces_no_benchmark_claim: This stage validates instrumentation. It yields no coverage, quality, capability or readiness claim, and no formal sample is consumed.
execution_stages.rationale: A repository audit on 2026-08-02 found the evaluation layer cannot execute this plan as written. There were zero occurrences of oracle, arm, ablation, full_history_baseline or raw_dense_retrieval anywhere in src, tests or scripts; ingestion carried only beam.py with no LoCoMo or LongMemEval loader; and the 32-item slice had no loader at all. Stage 2 cannot validate oracle substitutions that do not exist, and Stage 3 cannot run three arms that do not exist. This stage builds only the evaluation layer so that Stage 1's unrecoverable human adjudication is not spent before the harness is known to work.

requirements.freeze_once_proof: The loader must demonstrate that memory is built exactly once per conversation from public input, frozen and hashed, before any question is revealed. The proof is an artifact, not a comment.
requirements.metrics_compatibility: The existing QuestionMetrics fields keep their current meaning as a compatibility layer for prior BEAM results. New metrics are added alongside; no existing field is redefined, so earlier BEAM numbers remain comparable.
requirements.oracle_substitution_boundary: The five substitutions are gold extraction, gold memory mapping, gold L2 abstraction and derivation, gold query plan and gold evidence selection. Each replaces exactly one layer by dependency injection at the evaluation boundary. Production runtime, the mapper and the pipeline must contain no import path that reads gold. An oracle run is labelled as such and never reported as a system result.
requirements.three_arms: full_history, raw_dense_retrieval and ontology_memory must be comparable: identical questions, identical model and decoding settings, identical evidence and answer budgets, and one shared result contract. An arm that silently receives a different budget or a different question set is not a baseline.
requirements.unified_loader: One public-input contract across all three benchmarks. A loader exposes public conversation content only; question text, answers, gold evidence ids and rubrics travel on a separate gold channel that the memory mapper cannot reach.

budget_decision_accepted.full_history_basis: model context bound, not a sentinel
budget_decision_accepted.status: dev_derived_pending, frozen for the formal set
budget_decision_accepted.tokenizer_caveat: approximate and non-authoritative, so bounds are instrumentation-side and cannot guarantee a prompt fits

full_history_ruling_applied.before_formal_run: freeze full prompt serialization, tokenizer contract and system/prompt/output reserve; the approximate tokenizer cannot prove a request fits
full_history_ruling_applied.full_history_denominator: eligible 22, with coverage 22/32 and the ten ids in the headline
full_history_ruling_applied.full_history_ineligible: recorded not_executed_context_limit, never truncated and relabelled

new_finding_full_history_is_context_limi.consequence: For those items full_history is a truncated-history condition, not a complete-history capability ceiling, and the report labels it that way. No budget setting makes them fit; only a larger-context model would.
new_finding_full_history_is_context_limi.observation: The largest slice conversations measure about 130800 approximate tokens, which exceeds a 128000-token context once reserve is deducted. full_history is context limited on 10 of 32 items.
new_finding_full_history_is_context_limi.open_decision: Whether the formal run keeps these items under a labelled truncated-history condition, or excludes them from the full_history arm only, is a user decision.

C1_no_runtime_isolation.allowlist_published: SandboxManifest.visible_mounts lists the eight visible mounts, and the report asserts repository_mounted, question_channel_mounted and gold_channel_mounted are all false.
C1_no_runtime_isolation.finding: extra_import_roots was itself a path, and the child shared the filesystem namespace, so an empty working directory and a scrubbed environment proved nothing. A hostile probe confirmed it: reading a hard-coded absolute path returned all 32 gold items. The two earlier FileNotFoundErrors showed only that two relative paths were wrong.
C1_no_runtime_isolation.host_dependency: the interpreter lives on a JuiceFS FUSE mount that a new user namespace cannot see, so it is copied into local storage rather than bind-mounted. sandbox_available() gates the run and the script fails closed when namespaces are unavailable.
C1_no_runtime_isolation.resolution: sandboxed_build.py runs the build inside unprivileged user, mount, network and PID namespaces with a tmpfs root. Only a copied interpreter, /usr, /dev/{urandom,null,zero}, a fresh procfs and a staging directory holding the single builder module are present. The repository, question channel and gold channel are never mounted, so they are absent from the namespace rather than unreadable. Inherited descriptors above stdio are closed and networking is unshared.
C1_no_runtime_isolation.staging_rule: only the builder module file is copied into staging. A tests/ directory is never mounted, so a probe cannot reach its neighbours.
C1_no_runtime_isolation.verified: the same hostile probe now reports repo_visible false, home_visible false, known_absolute_readable false, sys.path search empty, __file__ parent search null, and 4 file descriptors. gold_items_read is absent where it previously reported 32.

C2_source_identity_still_exposed.finding: source_identity remained on the build input. Even an allowlisted schema version or content hash can be matched offline against a known corpus.
C2_source_identity_still_exposed.resolution: The field is removed from MemoryBuildInput entirely. It lives on LoadedBenchmark and is bound to the freeze receipt after the build finishes. The build input now carries exactly one field, conversations.
C2_source_identity_still_exposed.verified: set(MemoryBuildInput.model_fields) == {"conversations"}, and canonical_content exposes only build_input_schema and conversations.

C3_digest_mutation_coverage_incomplete.finding: The digest was claimed to bind all metadata levels but only session metadata was covered by a mutation test.
C3_digest_mutation_coverage_incomplete.resolution: Coverage extended to eleven mutations: turn text, speaker, token count and handle; session metadata and handle; conversation metadata and handle; an added turn; an added conversation; and array reordering. Reordering is additionally asserted to distinguish the two same-membership inputs from each other, not merely from the baseline.

round_five_notes.metric_standing: The report now classifies every figure as diagnostic_only and lists the three unfrozen contract items: tokenizer contract, full prompt serialization, and system/prompt/output reserve. Coverage 22/32, selection exact match 1.000 and recall 1.000 are explicitly marked as not citable as capability results or as evidence that a request fits the model context.
round_five_notes.self_inflicted_incident: An early sandbox attempt added the parent of sys.executable to the mount list, which bind-mounted over the project virtualenv bin directory and destroyed it. The venv was rebuilt with uv sync, and _library_roots now excludes anything inside sys.prefix and uses the base interpreter from pyvenv.cfg.

C1_question_and_gold_reachable_at_build.finding: The controller loaded public input, questions and gold into one process before running the builder, so a legitimate-looking builder reached 32 questions and 32 answers through a closure while the receipt still validated. A function signature is not runtime isolation.
C1_question_and_gold_reachable_at_build.resolution: isolated_build.py runs the build in a child process that receives the serialized build input on stdin, is given no file paths, and starts in an empty temporary directory with a scrubbed environment. Questions enter the controller process only after the child exits.
C1_question_and_gold_reachable_at_build.verified: a hostile probe builder attempting to open slice.json and gold.json returns "blocked: FileNotFoundError" for both, and sees only three content keys.

C2_mapper_saw_dataset_identity.finding: MemoryBuildInput carried a benchmark field, source_identity carried loader_id "regression-slice-loader", and handles such as slice-BEAM-100K-C001-abstention-001 disclosed benchmark, conversation and category. Tests only forbade those values in metadata and missed the formal fields and handles.
C2_mapper_saw_dataset_identity.resolution: The benchmark field is removed from the build input and lives on LoadedBenchmark, controller-side. loader_id is off the allowlist, leaving only build_input_schema_version. HandleMint assigns opaque handles (c00000/s00000/h00000) and keeps the translation controller-side; assert_handles_are_opaque rejects any handle carrying semantics.
C2_mapper_saw_dataset_identity.verified: all four loaders now emit opaque handles with gold references remapped through the mint.

C3_receipt_did_not_bind_public_content.finding: content_digest hashed only the handle structure, so changing a turn’s text from "original bytes" to "tampered bytes" left the digest identical. The receipt bound nothing about content.
C3_receipt_did_not_bind_public_content.resolution: content_digest is now SHA-256 over the full canonical build input, including turn text, speaker, token counts, session and conversation metadata, and source identity.
C3_receipt_did_not_bind_public_content.verified: a per-field mutation test asserts the digest moves for text, speaker, approximate_tokens, session metadata and source identity.

C4_slice_oracle_was_never_executed.finding: The oracle ran only on two synthetic fixtures while the report merely listed gold_evidence_selection as "reported" for the slice, with no substitution, no per-item closure and no ESEM. The 1.0 evidenced two fixtures, not the real 32-item path.
C4_slice_oracle_was_never_executed.resolution: The evidence-selection oracle now executes per item over all 32 slice questions, recording gold handles, selected handles and closure for each.
C4_slice_oracle_was_never_executed.verified: 32/32 items closed, selection exact match 1.000 on the real slice path.

round_four_important.I1_oracles_not_fail_closed: An unknown question id defaulted evidence refs to the empty set and produced selected=() instead of raising, so a typo became a plausible abstention. Substitution now raises on an unknown question id and on layer-gold identity mismatch, and LayerGold validates reference closure: mapping and L2 may not reference handles extraction gold does not produce, a plan may not request canonical ids neither mapping nor L2 can supply, and an abstraction may not have an empty derivation. All four paths verified.
round_four_important.I2_full_history_truncation_counted: Applied the ruling. Items whose conversation exceeds the model context are recorded not_executed_context_limit for full_history and excluded from its denominator; coverage 22/32 and the ten item ids are reported in the headline; cross-arm comparison uses the common eligible 22 while retrieval and memory arms are additionally reported over all 32. full_history now shows budget_limited=0 because it no longer truncates and claims to be full history.

C1_builder_saw_every_question.finding: PublicInput carried a questions tuple and the script handed the whole object to the builder, so all 32 questions were visible at build time. The receipt proved the wrapper ran once, not that the builder was blind.
C1_builder_saw_every_question.resolution: Three mutually incompatible channels. MemoryBuildInput has no question field at all and forbids extra fields, so a builder cannot receive a question even by mistake; QuestionChannel is released only through FrozenMemory.release_questions; GoldChannel is for the scorer and oracles. Question-blindness is now a property of the type rather than a claim in an artifact.
C1_builder_saw_every_question.verified: 'questions' not in MemoryBuildInput.model_fields, and a constructor call passing questions raises.

C2_metadata_defence_was_bypassable.finding: Only top-level keys were checked, source_identity was unchecked and carried gold_sha256, and assert_no_gold_reaches used isinstance so a question subclass with an answer field passed. All four counterexamples were reproduced.
C2_metadata_defence_was_bypassable.resolution: Replaced the denylist with a recursive positive allowlist: only named keys survive at any level, values must be scalars, and nested containers are refused outright rather than filtered. source_identity is allowlisted too. The question guard now tests exact type, not isinstance. Dataset-identifying fields (benchmark, split, question_type, sample_id, item_id, category) are excluded so a mapper cannot special-case a dataset.
C2_metadata_defence_was_bypassable.verified: seven regression tests in tests/unit/evaluation/test_channel_bypasses.py, one per bypass plus dataset-id and builder-signature checks.

C3_four_oracles_were_not_layer_gold.finding: GoldExtraction filtered input by the question's final evidence refs and GoldMemoryMapping tagged those same units, so both injected question relevance rather than substituting their layer. Worse, the L2 abstraction was computed and never consumed, so substituting it changed the trace and nothing scored; its ESEM stayed at the baseline 0.34375.
C3_four_oracles_were_not_layer_gold.resolution: Added independently authored per-layer gold artifacts (extraction roles and predicates, mapping canonical id and sense, L2 abstractions with derivations, frozen query plans). substitute() raises when the required layer gold is absent instead of falling back. The pipeline now routes selection through the L2 output via QueryPlan.requires_abstraction, so abstraction quality changes the scored result.
C3_four_oracles_were_not_layer_gold.slice_reporting_rule: The 32-item slice carries no extraction, mapping, L2 or query-plan annotation, so those four layers are reported only on the synthetic fixture and withheld from the slice run.
C3_four_oracles_were_not_layer_gold.verified: on the synthetic fixture, substituting the plan alone selects nothing while plan plus gold L2 selects exactly the gold set, which is only possible if L2 feeds selection.

round_three_important.I1_effectiveness_was_not_asserted: assert_substitution_is_effective now requires the target layer's output to have changed, in addition to forbidding upstream change. An inert substitution raises rather than being reported as executed.
round_three_important.I2_digest_was_not_a_hash: MemoryBuilder now takes a canonicalizer and computes SHA-256 of canonical bytes itself, so a caller cannot supply a payload as a digest. receipt() re-verifies the artifact internally rather than depending on the caller having called verify_artifact.
round_three_important.I3_stub_shaped_metrics: answer_correct, abstention_correct, critical_false_positive and constraint_satisfaction are all None when no real judge ran. Reporting zero satisfied constraints was no more honest than reporting all of them; both invent a result.
round_three_important.I4_budget_contract: The 100000000 sentinel is gone. full_history is bound to the model's real 128000-token context less answer and prompt reserve, with the tokenizer contract recorded as an explicitly non-authoritative approximation.

review_history.verdict: Two rejections. Round two fixed the LongMemEval leak path, the slice questions and the selection/delivery split; round three found three further Critical defects, all reproduced before rework.

execution_stages.scope_rule: Evaluation and ingestion layers only. Core memory semantics stay untouched: base ontology, dynamic ontology extension interface, L1 extraction, L2 abstraction, question handling, symbol-first recall and guarded embedding fallback are not modified.
execution_stages.stop_after: Stage 0.5 ends with a harness validation report and an explicit review. Stage 1 human ontology adjudication does not begin until that review is accepted.

batching.alpha_is_not_a_benchmark_claim: ontology-v0-alpha validates process only and supports no coverage, quality or readiness claim.

exit_criteria: every mapping output falls into one of the five declared mapping_outputs states
the adjudication ledger records a decision and a rationale for every case
inter-reviewer disagreement on the double-blind subset is measured and reported
no schema or guide change is pending
batch_1_alpha.purpose: Validate the annotation guide, the mapping-output vocabulary, the adjudication ledger format and the double-blind review procedure end to end.

batch_2_full.precondition: batch_1_alpha exit criteria are met and any guide or schema defect it exposed is fixed before batch 2 authoring begins
batch_2_full.size: the remaining cases up to 100 to 150 total

batching.guide_change_rule: A guide or schema change made after batch_1_alpha requires re-adjudicating the alpha cases under the new guide before they may join ontology-v0. Alpha cases are never silently carried forward under a changed guide.
batching.rationale: Human canonical-ontology adjudication cannot be delegated and is the single largest serial cost in this plan. Authoring 100 to 150 mapping-gold cases before any of the annotation workflow is validated risks discovering a guide or schema defect after all the expensive adjudication is already spent.

execution_stages.coverage_measurement_rule: The coverage and ambiguity report states O_L1 and O_L2 item counts against the declared scenario_families and cross_scenario_semantics, so that ontology adequacy is a measured quantity rather than an assumption. A prior taxonomy iteration carried roughly 7 O_L1 items and 3 O_L2 items, which covers only a fraction of the declared semantics; ontology-v0 must report its own counts and name every declared family or semantic dimension that has no corresponding ontology item.
execution_stages.name: ontology foundation pilot
execution_stages.rule: Freeze before end-to-end benchmark questions are exposed to the memory mapper.

execution_stages.depends_on_stage_0_5: Stage 2 cannot run before Stage 0.5 delivers the arms, oracle substitutions and slice loader, because its oracle-substitution self-tests and question-blind freeze proof have nothing to exercise otherwise.
execution_stages.name: harness and anti-cheating regression
outputs: no semantic heuristic or gate audit
execution_stages.rule: This stage validates instrumentation only and produces no benchmark claim.

execution_stages.incremental_persistence_rule: Every per-item artifact is written and flushed as it is produced, so that an interruption at item N preserves items 1 through N-1 as valid evidence rather than losing the run.
execution_stages.name: untouched diagnostic-v1 run
outputs: all intermediate L1, mapping, L2, query, evidence and answer artifacts
execution_stages.rule: One formal run under frozen inputs. No semantic repair or targeted rerun.

execution_stages.name: RCA and architecture diagnosis
outputs: architecture issue ledger with evidence levels
execution_stages.rule: Report findings only. Do not implement repairs.

external_system_boundary: Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, MemPalace, Zep and similar systems are not rerun in diagnostic-v1. Author-reported results remain external context only.

failure_attribution.architecture_change_candidate_rule: Only oracle_confirmed evidence, or a reproduced failure that is also cross_source, may enter a later architecture-change discussion.
method: Freeze the untouched failure and all relevant intermediate artifacts.
Locate the earliest incorrect module output.
Use the smallest pre-registered oracle substitution that can falsify the attribution.
Compare downstream change without modifying the formal run.
Assign one primary owner and record secondary propagation separately.
Do not repair, tune or rerun during diagnostic-v1.

actions: do not add ontology entries or aliases from formal failures
do not tune prompts, mapper, executor or answer model
do not rerun the formal sample
do not start a larger benchmark
do not rerun external memory systems
do not make benchmark-ready or production-ready claims
mandatory_stop.next_step: Return the RCA report to the user and wait for a separate decision about ontology expansion, module repairs, architecture changes and the design of a fresh evaluation.
mandatory_stop.trigger: The diagnostic-v1 RCA report and its immutable evidence index are complete.

forbidden_shortcuts: candidate retrieval that uses question or sample identity
reading gold evidence before memory freeze
freeze_order: Load the frozen ontology and public conversation only.
Map L1 and L2 to the complete frozen ontology without benchmark-derived candidate retrieval.
Freeze extraction, mapping, L1/L2 memory and provenance.
Only after memory freeze reveal the benchmark questions to query compilation.
mapper_anti_cheating_contract.query_mapper: Separate from the memory mapper but bound to the same complete frozen ontology and version hashes.
mapper_anti_cheating_contract.unsupported_query_rule: An unsupported query must be reported as executor capability failure. The task contract may not exclude it after inspection.

L1.revision: Append-only. Later information confirms, corrects, supersedes or conflicts with prior revisions instead of overwriting them.
L1.unit: A user message, agent message, tool message or tool event; surrounding context may resolve reference but may not supply an unstated fact.

L2.input: Frozen L1 units, their raw evidence and only the necessary prior context.
L2.reporting: Raw abstraction, ontology mapping, derivation and evidence closure are scored separately.
requirements: typed abstraction independent of O_L1 vocabulary
no benchmark question, future session or gold access

memory_construction_contract.answer_model_boundary: For the ontology arm, the answer model may read only the question, query plan, symbolic matches and selected EvidenceSpans. It may not read the full conversation history.

L1_L2_structure: L1 source, time, modality, polarity and lifecycle accuracy
no_compensation: L2 may not hide an L1 failure.
Final answer correctness may not hide wrong evidence.
A structural validator intervention may not hide raw semantic error.
retrieval_execution_answer: latency, tokens and cost when available

model_identity_verification.per_request_recording: Every formal-run artifact records the response model id alongside the requested id; a post-run audit asserts a single distinct response model id across the entire run.
model_identity_verification.rationale: A prior evaluation requested deepseek-chat and was served deepseek-v4-flash without the mismatch blocking the run, so its reported scores cannot be attributed to the intended model. Silent provider substitution invalidates the model identity that model_protocol.fixed claims to hold constant.
model_identity_verification.rule: Every request records the requested model id and the model id the provider returns. The run stops if they differ.
model_identity_verification.stage_0_probe: Stage 0 issues one live probe, asserts the response model id equals deepseek-v4-flash, and records the provider model list in the identity manifest.

reasoning_model_budget.decision: The answer role runs with thinking disabled. This makes the output budget cover visible content only, so answer_max_output_tokens returns to 1024 with ample headroom.
reasoning_model_budget.finding: Verified on 2026-08-02: deepseek-v4-flash defaults to emitting reasoning tokens that are billed as completion tokens. A max_tokens of 8 returned empty content with all 8 tokens consumed as reasoning; the same prompt at 800 returned 'ok' using 13 completion tokens of which 11 were reasoning. Passing thinking type disabled removes reasoning entirely: the same one-word prompt then used 1 completion token, and a multi-hop supersession question used 193 completion tokens with zero reasoning tokens versus 381 with reasoning, producing identical correct output including correct supersession.
reasoning_model_budget.recording: Every artifact records completion_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens separately, so a silent re-enabling of thinking is visible in the artifacts.
reasoning_model_budget.rule: A truncated response caused by an under-provisioned budget is an instrumentation defect and must not be scored as a semantic or schema failure.
reasoning_model_budget.structured_output: DeepSeek rejects response_format type json_schema with 'This response_format type is unavailable now' and accepts json_object, verified on 2026-08-02. Schema support is therefore a per-model setting: the answer role uses json_object while the judge role keeps json_schema. Because json_object does not enforce a schema at the provider, answer payloads are validated locally and a schema violation is a scored failure rather than a repaired one.

model_protocol.retry: Only a transport failure may resend the byte-identical request. A semantic or schema failure is a scored failure and is not retried.

not_transport_failures: HTTP 200 with content that fails schema validation
a truncated response caused by an adequate-but-exhausted budget
a refusal or an off-schema natural-language reply
retry_bound.on_exhaustion: Record the request as an unrecoverable transport failure, mark the item incomplete, and trigger the partial_run procedure. Do not substitute a different model, relax the schema, or reword the prompt.
retry_bound.rationale: An unbounded transport retry is a rerun loophole: it lets a semantic failure be reclassified as a transport failure and retried until it passes.
retry_bound.transport_failure_definition: A connection error, timeout, or HTTP 429/5xx received with no parseable response body.

roles.judge: Scores answer correctness. gpt-5.5 at the api.penguinsaichat.dpdns.org proxy, credential KE_MEMORY_JUDGE_API_KEY, response_format json_schema.
roles.judge_independence: Because the judge is a different model family from the generator, answer correctness is an independent judgement rather than self-evaluation.
roles.judge_provider_caveat: The judge runs behind a third-party proxy, which gives no guarantee about which upstream model actually serves a request. model_identity_verification therefore applies to the judge as well: its served model id is recorded per request and asserted stable across the run, and a mismatch stops the run. If the proxy cannot return a stable model id, judge verdicts are reported as provider-unverified.
roles.two_model_rule: The generator and the judge are deliberately different models so that answer correctness is not self-evaluated. Both roles, both providers and both model identities are declared here; no role may route anywhere undeclared.
roles.work: Generates the answers being scored. deepseek-v4-flash at api.deepseek.com, credential KE_MEMORY_WORK_API_KEY, thinking disabled, response_format json_object.

model_protocol.stability_check: Pre-register repeated inference on 10 percent of the sample and report disagreement; repetition is for stability measurement, not majority-vote repair.
model_protocol.stability_check_isolation: Stability repetitions are written to a separate stability namespace, never overwrite the first formal response, and never contribute to any primary metric. Only the first formal response per item feeds the metric tables; the stability subset is reported as disagreement rate only.

official_arms.purpose: Measure answer capability when no memory compression or ontology mapping is required.

official_arms.input: raw evidence units under the same question and answer budget
one query-blind frozen memory build plus symbolic query execution
official_arms.purpose: Measure the current architecture and ontology mapping path.

ontology_foundation_pilot.language: English only for diagnostic-v1; canonical ids are language-neutral and aliases carry language tags.

mandatory_second_review: suspected false merge or false split

target_scale.coverage_spans: approximately 500 spans for automatic candidate mining and coverage analysis

ontology_model.Extended_AMR: An extension of AMR's ontology space and an instance-graph encoding bound to canonical ontology items. It is a possible carrier, not the preselected carrier and not a competitor to KEOL.
ontology_model.KEOL: A method for dynamic ontology construction: unmapped expressions become candidates that can be normalized, deduplicated, conflict-checked, admitted or rejected, and versioned. In diagnostic-v1 it is observed only as a side track and is not a core scored capability.

foundation_layout.O_L1: Atomic event, state, preference, task and attribute ontology. Frozen and hashed independently.
foundation_layout.O_L2: Cross-turn and cross-session abstraction ontology. Frozen and hashed independently from O_L1.
foundation_layout.cross_layer_map: Explicit versioned derivation/import map. Shared vocabulary is never implicit.
foundation_layout.domain_namespaces: Versioned domain/* namespaces for scenario-specific concepts; dataset/* namespaces are forbidden as containers for answer-specific benchmark concepts.
foundation_layout.memory_core: Shared cross-scenario concepts for provenance, identity, time, modality, polarity, conflict, supersession, evidence and lifecycle.

ontology_model.ontology: A versioned namespace of stable ids, senses, aliases, types, relations, roles and constraints. A bare string vocabulary is insufficient because mapping correctness requires identity and sense.

actions: Stop the stage at the point of failure and make no further model requests.
Freeze every artifact already produced, unmodified, including the failing item's raw request and response.
Record the last completed item index, the failure point, the failure class and the raw error.
Mark the run partial_run in its manifest and record how many of the pre-registered items completed.
Report the partial result to the user with its completion count stated.
partial_run.definition: A formal stage that begins but does not complete, for any reason including transport exhaustion, corpus defect, environment failure, budget exhaustion or operator interruption.
partial_run.diagnostic_value_rule: A partial run caused by an instrumentation or environment defect is a valid finding about the harness and is reported as such. It is not a finding about memory or ontology quality.
forbidden: rerunning the same pre-registered formal sample after a partial run
resuming into the same formal artifact set and presenting the result as one complete run
repairing the failure cause and continuing within the same formal run
computing headline metrics as though the sample were complete
discarding completed items to make the run look clean
reclassifying a semantic failure as a transport failure in order to retry it
partial_run.metrics_rule: Metrics from a partial run are reported only over completed items, always alongside the completion count and the pre-registered sample size. They are labelled partial and are never compared against a complete run.
partial_run.resumption_rule: A partial run is never resumed. Continuing requires a separately pre-registered fresh sample and an explicit user decision, which is the same mandatory_stop boundary that governs a completed run.

current_status.broad_foundation_pending_natural_coverag: breadth is not settled by the 100 and 32 item counts. It is settled by the ontology ceiling observed on natural expression, the shape of the remaining gap categories, and coverage of common memory situations. The two known gaps stay recorded.
current_status.diagnostic_execution_chain_ready: the nine-stage chain runs over a consumed builder artifact with per-layer traces, and the oracle attribution mechanism holds. The layers are lexical, so this is diagnostic capability only.
current_status.formal_benchmark_not_yet_ready: the critical path is ontology v2 and natural-expression mapper validation. The judge key can be handled in parallel and is not what gates the run.
current_status.mapper_v1_diagnostic_failed_as_expected: 7 of 18 correct with all four negatives mis-mapped. A repair attempt on discovery data reached 12.5 percent abstention against v1 baseline 9.8 percent and is not a fix; the diagnosis is that lexical overlap is too weak a signal for the abstain decision.
current_status.mapper_v2_not_yet_built: the lexical repair attempt is retired. Mapper v2 has not been built: candidate generation must be rebuilt on WordNet lemmas and senses, PropBank predicates and rolesets, schema.org types and properties, and the native O_L1/O_L2 aliases and type constraints.
current_status.natural_mapping_quality_not_yet_measured: the 18 cases were composed by reading ontology items, which makes them a controlled mapper probe. They say nothing about mapping quality on natural expression.
current_status.ontology_sources_frozen: WordNet 3.0, PropBank 3.4.0 and schema.org 30.0 acquired and frozen at explicit commits with licences and independent hashes. They have not yet been used to extend the ontology.
current_status.ontology_v2_recovered_candidate_frozen: six units frozen with independent digests. Recovered from a crashed build, so it is a candidate freeze and may not be described as a clean, reproducible ontology build.

attribution_classes: ontology sense, alias or type defect

blindness_evidence.enforced_by: MapperInput has no field for any of these and forbids extras; expression_id is rejected if it discloses dataset identity

chain_installation.rerun_rule: the 32 items were rerun only to revalidate trace, artifact consumption and oracles; not a fresh evaluation
chain_installation.why_two_slots: installing the mapper in the mapping slot alone drove selection from 19 of 32 to 0 of 32. The mapper was correct; the planner was the unmigrated layer, still emitting lex:* terms against l1:* ontology ids, so no plan could intersect a mapping. A mapper is only usable when the query side shares its vocabulary.

mapper_v1.chain_installation_rule: mapper v1 replaces the lexical mapping slot, then the 32 items are rerun only to confirm the trace, artifact consumption and oracles still hold. That slice is not re-treated as a fresh evaluation.
mapper_v1.data_rule: the 18 authored cases are regression-only from now on. They are a controlled probe and are retired as a qualification set.

defects_found_in_mapper_v1.defect: confidence normalised only by the item vocabulary, so a single decisive alias hit scored 1/12 and fell under the floor
defects_found_in_mapper_v1.fix: confidence is the stronger of item recall and utterance precision
defects_found_in_mapper_v1.symptom: every utterance mapped to nothing, including "cancel my flight reservation"

defects_found_in_mapper_v1.defect: the no-correction-gate check scanned raw text and matched its own banned-name list
defects_found_in_mapper_v1.fix: parse the module and inspect defined function names instead of substrings
defects_found_in_mapper_v1.symptom: the checker reported itself as a violation and the run aborted

mapper_v1.degeneracy: all four negative cases were mis-mapped, so the mapper almost never declines an irrelevant expression. This must be removed before any fresh benchmark, independently of the score.

gold.provenance_rule: each case was written by reading an O_L1 or O_L2 item and composing an utterance that should evoke it. No case was derived from any benchmark question or evidence gold.

mapper_v1.gold_rule: mapping gold is authored independently and never back-derived from evidence gold. Clear items get a single review; novel, ambiguous, L2 and disputed items get a second independent adjudication, which keeps the manual volume bounded.
mapper_v1.input_rule: natural expression plus the frozen O_L1/O_L2 only. Questions, gold, split, dataset name and sample ids are all forbidden inputs.
mapper_v1.metric_rule: reported separately for L1 and L2
order: install mapper v1 into the nine-stage chain
mapper_v1.output_rule: raw top-k candidates, sense, confidence, ambiguity and unresolved are preserved. No semantic correction gate, no post-hoc repair of an error.

repair_attempt.conclusion: lexical alias overlap cannot separate "this turn attests a preference" from "this turn contains a word listed in a preference alias". Each calibration fixes one side at the cost of the other because the signal is too weak, not because the threshold is wrong.
repair_attempt.discipline_note: tuning was stopped rather than continued. Further adjustment would have been fitting the retired 18-case probe and would have produced a number without a mechanism.
repair_attempt.outcome: five successive calibrations moved abstention 0.098, 0.073, 0.998, 0.000, 0.405, 0.125 on 1500 discovery turns and never got correct short mappings and correct abstentions right at once.
repair_attempt.recommendation: rebuild candidate generation on WordNet lemmas and senses, PropBank predicates and rolesets, schema.org types and properties, and the native ontology v2 aliases and type constraints.
root_causes_found: a raw IDF sum has no fixed range, so an absolute score floor cannot be calibrated against it
normalising by observed terms made the score fall with turn length; normalising by item weight penalised richly aliased items
a fixed stopword list deleted 14 terms the ontology declares as aliases, including "like" for hold_attitude and "than" for the comparative preference
protecting those terms then let "and", "for" and "every" count as decisive evidence
ranking by score alone put a protected stopword above the real alias, and since the abstain check inspects only the top candidate, the whole mapping was discarded as generic

results.attribution_rule: a failure is assigned to every class its evidence admits; no single owner is forced. The mentions therefore sum above the failure count.

metrics_l1.coverage_note: fraction of cases where the mapper returned any candidate

metrics_l2.coverage_note: fraction of cases where the mapper returned any candidate

mapper_v1.standing: diagnostic. The mapper is lexical over a seed ontology and the gold set is 18 authored cases, so these figures detect gross behaviour rather than production mapping accuracy.

gold_layer_asymmetry.note: gold names 5 L2 targets against 231 L1. L2 accuracy will therefore rest on very few cases and must be reported with its denominator rather than as a rate.

isolation_proof.method: grep over both packages for the sample, the gold and the validation directory

l2_path.consequence_for_reading_results: the layers take different paths on purpose: L1 is recognition from lexical and structural evidence, L2 is derivation over attested L1 items. A single figure spanning both would hide that.
l2_path.fixed: L2 now derives from L1 candidates through the frozen map. Each entry declares l1_source_ids and an evidence_required count, and both are honoured.
l2_path.found: directly indexed by alias, which is wrong. "I go running every Tuesday without fail" returned no_map because the utterance contains no word from the habit item aliases ["routine","usually does","regular practice"]. An abstraction is recognised from what attests it, not from its own name.
l2_path.mechanism_verified: 32 rules covering all 32 L2 items; the habit rule fires at exactly 3 of its 4 declared sources and stays silent at 2, so evidence_required is enforced rather than advisory
l2_path.question: is L2 directly indexed, or derived through M_L1_to_L2

no_map_metric_definitions.false_mapping_rate_on_gold_none: the share of gold none expressions the mapper mapped anyway, reported separately from out_of_scope
no_map_metric_definitions.no_map_precision: of the expressions the mapper declined, the share gold also expects nothing for
no_map_metric_definitions.no_map_recall: of the expressions gold expects nothing for, the share the mapper declined

output_format_alignment.mapping_rule: gold concept maps to mapper mapped; gold ambiguous to ambiguous; gold none and out_of_scope both expect no_map, but they are scored separately because none means the ontology should not cover it while out_of_scope means the ontology cannot, and only the second measures the ceiling.

source_filter_rules.ontology_v2: single-word aliases are decisive; multi-word aliases match only as whole phrases
source_filter_rules.propbank: 11205 rolesets indexed; light verbs excluded from structural evidence because be.01 is a real roleset and made every copular sentence look structural
source_filter_rules.schemaorg: 933 of 1010 classes and 1521 of 1676 properties carry a usable label; the difference is nodes without rdfs:label
source_filter_rules.wordnet: lemma, part of speech and sense count only; polysemy above 4 is not standalone evidence

next_sequence.name: freeze the mapper v1 failure record
next_sequence.rule: the 18 cases become regression-only and may never again serve as fresh qualification

decision_provenance_marker.meaning: those acceptances were derived from each item's own recorded provenance, which closes the ledger completeness gap. It is not independent semantic review, and the two must not be conflated: a derived decision cites the evidence that admitted the item, and nobody re-judged whether the item should exist.

defects_found_during_recovery: a gloss floor of min_length=8 rejected real PropBank data: decide.01 is named exactly "decide", six characters. Verified against the frozen archive and the floor lowered to 3.

the ledger covered 20 of 132 items, so 112 had entered a layer with no recorded review. Decisions are now derived from each item's own provenance, so a decision cites the evidence that admitted the item rather than a reason written afterwards.
the ledger had zero rejections, which would imply nothing was ever turned away. v1's 25 rejections and its still-open deferrals are carried forward with their original reasoning.
two provenance helpers left by the crash were unreferenced dead code and were removed.
next_sequence.independent_verification: the six unit digests were recomputed from the assembled ontology and matched the artifacts on disk; the two layers share no id; all 32 L2 items are derived through the map; every item now carries a ledger decision; and no Individual, date literal or dataset token appears in either layer.
next_sequence.name: build O_L1/O_L2 v2
next_sequence.recovery_note: the building agent died mid-write on a gateway 524 and left six modules on disk with no build script, no package marker and a truncated decisions module. The content was recovered rather than rebuilt: all six modules parsed, so the missing builders, provenance and ledger assembly were completed and the artifacts emitted.
next_sequence.reproducibility_boundary: the six digests prove the identity of the current bytes. They do not prove the ontology can be regenerated, because the original build script was lost with the crash. A recovery receipt is required before the formal benchmark, recording the crash state, the recovery rule, which fields are original versus reconstructed, and the verification performed. It must not be presented as a clean rebuild.
next_sequence.rule: no bulk import. The result must be stable ids, senses, aliases, roles and types suited to common memory situations, which is a curation problem rather than a volume problem.

next_sequence.isolation_evidence: zero overlap with the discovery turns the mapper line may read. Splitting by question id alone was insufficient: seven utterances recurred verbatim across conversations on the first draw, so isolation is enforced by exact text.
next_sequence.name: freeze the natural-expression validation sample and its split
next_sequence.naturalness_evidence: no expression is a verbatim ontology alias, and none was composed by reading an ontology item. Eligibility is by length only, since filtering on whether the ontology covers a turn would bias the sample toward what the ontology already knows and flatter the ceiling measurement.
next_sequence.ordering_guarantee: frozen while mapper v2 does not exist, so the sample cannot have shaped its thresholds
next_sequence.rule: sample from real conversations; never construct a case by reading an ontology item. Opaque ids only. The expressions are frozen before mapper v2 development starts, so the sample cannot drive the optimisation.

defects_found_and_fixed: a term appearing inside any phrase alias, plus a low-polysemy lemma, was enough to generate a candidate: "Mm hmm right okay then" produced two. Evidence must now be admissible on its own.
be.01 is a real PropBank roleset, so every copular sentence looked structural and "the weather has been mild" matched three predicates. Light verbs are excluded from structural evidence.
phrase aliases were indexed word by word, so "work" reached event.attempt_failed through the alias "didn't work". A phrase is evidence only when the phrase appears.
the preposition "out" counted as a predicate for the same reason.

discovery_behaviour.basis: 1500 discovery-split turns; the validation sample was never read by this line

indices_built.propbank: 9087 predicates, 11205 rolesets (matches the source freeze exactly)

ontology_source_debt.effect_on_ontology_v1: the sourcing bar on calling v1 a broad foundation ontology is lifted. The seed is still 67 and 20 items, so breadth remains a question of content rather than provenance.
ontology_source_debt.hash_rule: one independent sha256 per source; no combined digest stands in for the three
ontology_source_debt.independent_verification: the three raw archive hashes were recomputed from /public/home/wwb/datasets/ontology-sources and matched the manifest; the three snapshot hashes were recomputed from the artifacts and matched; parsed counts are non-trivial (PropBank 11205 rolesets over 9087 predicates and 28616 roles, schema.org 1010 classes and 1676 properties, WordNet 45 lexnames).
ontology_source_debt.prose_constraints: unchanged: prose constraint expressions still do not count toward any executable-constraint metric.
ontology_source_debt.rule: each must be acquired and frozen at an explicit version. This does not block mapper v1 diagnosis, but until it is complete the current ontology may not be called a broad foundation ontology.

schemaorg.resolved_version: schema.org 30.0; blob e69c25e9b6c3ab08557f80ad1c10dae0d6b25766 (data/releases/30.0/schemaorg-current-https.jsonld at release v30.0, commit 420231f6bfac8372fc564abb121fae57ccb36a0c)

wordnet.licence: WordNet 3.0 Licence (Princeton University); permissive, requires the copyright notice and disclaimer to be retained
wordnet.resolved_version: WordNet 3.0; nltk_data blob 3c68cd207844f071a5206f7fbed23e5c607ec02f (packages/corpora/wordnet.zip at gh-pages commit 550b6625bcef1f2abff2ff770a5a0d272c9c6b2a)

ontology_source_debt.still_outstanding: the acquired sources are frozen snapshots and have not yet been consulted to extend O_L1/O_L2. Folding them in is a separate ontology version.

program_plan.rationale: C1 to C3 restored measurement credibility. They do not confer Stage 2 capability, so the work now switches from repairing instruments to exposing real system behaviour.
program_plan.shape: two parallel tracks converging on one formal run

stage_0_close_out.authorisation: instrument credibility only; Stage 2 is not authorised by this
stage_0_close_out.open_gap: the ontology arm records memory_artifact_sha256 but no stage consumes the artifact. Recording a hash is not consumption, and this gap stays open until Track B closes it.

acceptance: a substitution changes only its target layer
the builder artifact is demonstrably consumed
stage_3_rehearsal.data_rule: the 32 items are never fresh hidden again
stage_3_rehearsal.explicitly_not: no model quality threshold and no targeted repair
stage_3_rehearsal.purpose: validate the real chain and the attribution tooling
stage_3_rehearsal.review_verdict: instrument acceptance passed. The 19 of 32 figure is a post-fix dev regression result and is neither an ontology nor a mapper score.

stage_4_formal.critical_path_correction: an earlier note framed the formal benchmark as waiting on the judge key. That was wrong. Three things stand on the critical path: the ontology is still a 67 and 20 item seed, mapper v1 scores 7 of 18 while mis-mapping every negative, and no natural-expression mapping quality has been measured. Running fresh data before the known degeneracy is removed would only reproduce a conclusion already in hand.
stage_4_formal.external_systems: Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight and similar are not rerun
stage_4_formal.full_history_rule: over-context items are marked context_ineligible and affect only that arm's denominator; they do not vanish from the benchmark
stage_4_formal.preflight_gate: only after mapper v1, the ontology source boundary and the real chain converge. One run on a fresh set; the 32 items are never reused as hidden; external systems are not rerun; and a formal result may not be answered by changing the ontology, mapper, gold or scoring rules.
stage_4_formal.result_discipline: a formal result exposes problems. Gates, gold, ontology and mapper are not adjusted because a number is unflattering; a fix belongs to a new version and a new fresh set.

track_a_ontology.discovery_split_rule: the discovery split may contribute general gap candidates only. It may not read questions, gold, dataset identity, and may not yield sample-specific aliases.
track_a_ontology.freeze_rule: each unit versioned and hashed independently; the two layers do not share a vocabulary by default
track_a_ontology.independent_verification: the three unit hashes were recomputed from the artifacts and matched; O_L1 and O_L2 share zero ids; all 20 L2 items are declared in the map and all 45 map references resolve; no Individual or benchmark literal appears in either layer.
track_a_ontology.keol_role: offline construction and normalization only; dynamic admission is not a core capability here
track_a_ontology.mapper_gate: blind evaluation may now begin, since the ontology is frozen
track_a_ontology.name: foundation ontology v1, then mapper blind evaluation
track_a_ontology.non_criteria: scale is not a pass condition, and a coverage gap may not be masked by online vocabulary expansion
residual_caveats: constraint expression fields are prose in a fixed shape, not executable; nothing in v1 evaluates them, which was chosen over shipping a DSL that would imply enforcement the freeze cannot back
l2:abstraction.habit rests on the weakest evidence in either layer (80 of 65245 MSC sentences state a frequency) and carries that limitation in the item itself
track_a_ontology.review_verdict: sufficient to start mapper blind testing. At 67 and 20 items with three external sources never actually consulted, it may not be called a broad foundation ontology covering common memory situations. The term is withheld until the source debt is paid.
track_a_ontology.unconsulted_note: none are available offline: nltk is absent, no PropBank copy exists and outbound HTTPS to schema.org timed out. Predicate senses are labelled corpus-clustered from SGD intent verbs rather than claiming synset ids, and no schema.org type name appears anywhere.

artifact_consumption.evidence: the builder now emits a handle-addressable index with per-turn digests instead of counts, and every layer trace carries the artifact digest. assert_artifact_read_by_every_layer rejects a mismatch, so a layer reaching back to the corpus fails rather than passing silently.

track_b_real_architecture.artifact_rule: the ontology arm must actually read the frozen artifact; recording a sha256 does not count

first_real_system_defect_found.defect: LexicalMapping took sorted(terms)[0], so numeric tokens won alphabetically and nearly every unit mapped to a digit id. Overlap with any question was empty and baseline selection was 0 of 32.
first_real_system_defect_found.fix: numeric tokens excluded and a unit maps to several ids; baseline selection is now 19 of 32
first_real_system_defect_found.standing: this is a fixture defect, not an ontology finding
first_real_system_defect_found.why_it_was_invisible_before: the previous fixture ran beside the chain rather than as a layer of it, so there was no real mapping stage whose output could be inspected.

track_b_real_architecture.name: real execution chain with per-layer traces
track_b_real_architecture.oracle_rule: the five oracles must replace real layers and exist only in the evaluation process. Report single-layer and cumulative substitution together; a zero single-layer gain does not license the conclusion that the module is sound.
track_b_real_architecture.remaining_limitation: the layers are lexical. They are real layers of the chain and each slot accepts a stronger backend, but no number here measures the ontology or a production mapper.
track_b_real_architecture.review_verdict: the nine-stage chain, artifact consumption and the oracle attribution mechanism all hold. The layers remain lexical implementations and may not be described as production capability.
track_b_real_architecture.sensitivity_rule: module sensitivity is recorded only where an oracle demonstrably changes the result; no single root cause is forced

single_and_cumulative.reading: a zero single-layer rate means necessary but not sufficient, not inert. The cumulative series reaching 1.0 at four layers is what shows they compose.

track_b_real_architecture.trace_rule: each layer emits an independent trace with input and output hashes and a failure status

forbidden: heuristic keyword or regular-expression semantic correction
semantic gates that correct model output or force abstention
contract narrowing that removes unsupported natural questions
targeted prompt or ontology optimization against formal failures
rerunning the same formal set after a semantic repair
semantic_assistance_policy.invalid_structure_rule: Invalid structure is scored as an error; integrity checks do not repair semantics.
semantic_assistance_policy.reporting_rule: Raw model and mapper quality is reported directly. A structural rejection is not evidence that the model understood the case.

source_plan.reachability_rule: The repository-relative path is the authoritative reference and must resolve from any worktree or clone. The main_worktree_origin field records provenance only; it lives under an untracked .runs/ directory that is NOT reachable from a worktree or a fresh clone and must never be the path a script resolves. Stage 0 verifies the repository-relative copy against sha256 and stops on mismatch or absence.
source_plan.rule: The source plan remains immutable. This v2.1 document is the self-contained approved successor for diagnostic-v1.

stage_failure_semantics.rationale: A stage without a defined failure branch invites an undeclared repair-and-retry loop, which is exactly how a prior effort turned each gate failure into a fresh round of refreezing rather than a reported result.
stage_failure_semantics.rule: Every stage has an explicit failure branch. Stage 0 stops the run outright. Stages 1 through 4 enter the partial_run procedure. No stage may respond to its own failure by repairing the cause and retrying in place.

bimodality_gap.note: three bases exist and each is labelled. Only the runtime basis measures what the answer path sends; the others are retained to explain an earlier apparent contradiction.

contract_freeze.exit: every item hashed separately, then the eligible set and coverage recomputed
contract_freeze.independent_verification: the four section hashes were recomputed from the artifact and matched; the reserve arithmetic was checked to be self-consistent (124285 = 128000 - 116 - 15 - 1024 - 2560); and the eligible set was recounted from the slice, giving 22 eligible and 10 ineligible, all BEAM.
items: tokenizer name, version, implementation, parameters and counting method
exact byte representation of system, prompt and turn serialization
context window, system/prompt/output reserve and safety margin
contract_freeze.judge_dependency: none; the judge key does not gate this track
contract_freeze.reserve_arithmetic: 128000 context - 116 system - 15 envelope - 1024 output - 2560 margin (2%) = 124285 evidence
residual_caveats: the tokenizer remains a non-authoritative character approximation, so every figure bounds instrumentation and cannot guarantee a request fits the model context
the 128000 context window is vendor-published, not measured against the API
contract_freeze.review_verdict: accepted only as a diagnostic contract draft. The four hashes recompute correctly, but they bind a synthetic PublicTurn triple rather than the real answer request, and no runtime consumes them, so they do not constrain a formal run.

runtime_bound_freeze.how_it_binds: the freeze calls the same build_answer_request the answer path calls and reads enforced_in_production from the AnswerService source, refusing to freeze an unenforced budget. The 8192-token module constant is gone and the budget is injected with an arm identity.

hashes.combined_hash_scope: SHA-256 over the four hashes above; a convenience digest that must not be cited in place of the individual four
hashes.hash_scope: each digest is SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of its own contract section only, so a change to one contract moves exactly one hash

superseded_draft.why_superseded: it hashed a three-field PublicTurn triple and summed per-turn rounded estimates. The four hashes recompute correctly and describe a shape nothing sends, so they carry no authority.

contract_freeze.zero_delta_explanation: coverage stayed at 22/32 even though measurement became stricter (serialization overhead now charged, up to 6610 tokens) and the budget tightened by 643. The set held because the slice is bimodal by a margin far wider than either change, which the artifact measures rather than asserts.

analysis_isolation.evidence: the analysing process sees 244 of 500 gold labels, its own split and no more. An earlier version isolated only a probe while the published ledger was computed in a parent holding the whole corpus.
analysis_isolation.mechanism: the published analysis runs inside the namespace, receiving one split payload on stdin. The parent computes no observation, so the analysing process never holds another split's gold.

corpus_discovery.attribution_rule: failures may not be attributed wholesale to ontology insufficiency
corpus_discovery.build_order: the corpus is built in the sandbox from conversations only; splits are then materialized and the analysis consumes one split payload inside a second sandbox. The parent computes no observation.
corpus_discovery.build_rule: the builder receives conversations only; questions and gold load in the controller after the sandboxed build exits
classifier_defects_found: a first run reported 78 of 79 observations as extraction failures; session-level gold references were compared against turn handles, which opaque handles made impossible to resolve by prefix
a second run reported 243 of 244 after the expansion was fixed, because the unresolvable check still subtracted turn handles from session references
both were classifier defects rather than findings; a near-total concentration in one class is the signal that the classifier is wrong
corpus_discovery.corpus: longmemeval-oracle, 500 conversations, built once inside the sandbox
corpus_discovery.delivery_budget_semantics: gold feasibility is measured against the 24576-token delivery budget inside the analysis, not the full-context budget, which had made the test vacuous.
corpus_discovery.entry: a clean commit of the frozen harness
corpus_discovery.held_out_isolation: structural: the held-out split file is not present in the analysis namespace
issue_ledger_classes: entity, role and predicate normalization gaps
genuine ontology type, relation or operator gaps
abstention, time, modality, negation, conflict and update handling errors
corpus_discovery.judge_dependency: none; this is why the tracks were split
corpus_discovery.no_forced_primary_owner: shapes describe what happened; possible_owners is unordered. The previous ledger assigned query_compiler and evidence_closure as primary classes and claimed evidence was available and expressible, neither of which a lexical fixture can establish.
corpus_discovery.pipeline_caveat: the pipeline is the lexical fixture, not the ontology backend, so the ledger locates where a real backend must do better and is not a measurement of the ontology

shape_inventory.no_primary_owner: possible_owners is unordered and no forced primary owner is recorded, because the real layers did not run

still_required_before_stage_2: a per-layer trace through the real architecture, or oracle substitution, before any observation may be attributed to a module
the sandbox build artifact must actually feed the diagnostic pipeline
corpus_discovery.what_this_is: shape inventory produced inside the isolation sandbox from one split payload. Shapes describe what happened; possible_owners is unordered and no primary owner is chosen, because the real extraction, mapping, ontology, query-compilation and retrieval layers did not run

formal_benchmark.judge_dependency: hard; the judge key must be rotated first and no judge call is permitted before then
formal_benchmark.reporting_rule: cross-arm comparison uses the common eligible set; retrieval and ontology arms may also report full coverage but denominators may never be mixed. Report representation coverage, ranking, evidence closure, constraint and abstention behaviour and end-to-end utility together; a single ESEM or recall figure may not be cited as system capability.

harness_review.exit: reviewer accepts, then a clean commit records code, report, test log and sandbox manifest hashes
harness_review.scope_note: Round-four scope is closed: no new threat model or architectural requirement is in scope. The seven verification points are addressed and each is backed by a test.

track_status.rationale: A single plan status let the judge key block everything, including corpus analysis that does not need a judge at all. Four independent statuses let corpus discovery start as soon as the harness is frozen.
